There's a detail built into almost every temple, courtroom and palace on Earth, and it isn't decoration: stairs. The person in power is always physically higher than you, and you have to climb to reach them.

It isn't symbolic. The moment you look up at someone, your nervous system reads them as bigger and more dangerous than you, and you defer - before a word is spoken.

The CIA studies this. So does Madison Avenue. So, allegedly, does the Brotherhood. Count the stairs next time you walk into a courthouse.

clips.caption:
There's a book that was originally part of the Bible for Jews and Christians, written by Noah's great-grandfather, and at some point it was quietly taken out. It survived anyway, found among the Dead Sea Scrolls in a cave in Israel.

It's written in first person. The author describes God descending from the sky in a "chariot of fire," taking him up above the earth, and pointing out that the earth is round and the moon only reflects the sun's light - centuries before anyone else recorded knowing either thing.

Read it today and it doesn't sound like scripture. It sounds like contact.
